_readme: OpenHistoricalMap countries laid over the Cliopatria base on the maps from 1900 to 1960, besides the hand-checked European lists in build-data.mjs (OHM) and HistoGIS: by map, [relation id, our name, options], largest first (where two overlap, the later one wins). Options: props (ruler s, note w) for the shape, adopts (Cliopatria polities that are the same country: they take this name). Names follow the reviewed maps where a relation is the same land as one of their shapes. Territories OHM files below the country level (Papua, the Far Eastern Republic, the protectorates of French Indochina and others) come last in each list. Generated from OHM and checked against CShapes; relations left out are listed in `left out` and `left out by map`.

left out.2846233: British Western Pacific Territories: a high commission over the Solomons, the Gilbert and Ellice Islands and others, which are drawn themselves
left out.2846235: British Western Pacific Territories: as above
left out.2846236: British Western Pacific Territories: as above
left out.2846238: British Western Pacific Territories: as above

1900.2808118: Mosquito Reserve: taken back by Nicaragua in 1894

1914.2917202: Upper Senegal and Niger: its outline runs over Senegal, a colony of its own; French West Africa is shown whole, as on the reviewed map

1920.2848317: Emirate of Transjordan: founded in April 1921; in 1920 the land was part of the Palestine mandate

1945.2746077: North Vietnam: drawn over all of Vietnam, which the Democratic Republic claimed in September 1945 while France retook the south; France still ruled Indochina in law
1945.2865791: British occupation of the Comoros Islands: Britain handed the Comoros, with Madagascar, to the Free French in 1943
